name: SUPER
description: SUPER is a benchmark designed to evaluate large language models' ability to autonomously set up and execute tasks from machine learning and NLP research repositories. It includes end-to-end problems, sub-problems focusing on specific challenges, and automatically generated problems to assess task success and progress.
reputation: A new but increasingly cited benchmark for agentic code execution on ML/NLP repositories, mainly used in recent research on autonomous software engineering and tool-using LLMs.
notes: Includes 45 expert-annotated end-to-end problems, 152 sub-problems, and 602 auto-generated problems; state-of-the-art models struggle on this benchmark.
